title: Profile
intro: Couple traveling Sept 1–14, 2026. Relaxed, cultural pace across China and Vietnam. $20,000 total budget with splurge in Vietnam. Decision-making by consensus (vote).

tables.caption: Preferences
rows: Late brunch, beach walk, exciting city/nature views
4–5 star; resorts OK; US booking sites

bullets.heading: Past Travel Lessons
items: Local mass transit worked great in prior multi-country trips
Taxis were a ripoff — avoid street taxis

callouts.text: Large crowds — avoid peak hours, book early-entry tickets
Heat — schedule outdoor activity for early morning / late afternoon
Both travelers in excellent physical condition — no mobility limits
